hero.description: Tham Nam is not a normal walk-in cave: water is the route, and visitors typically move through the low cave on an inner tube while following the cave line into the darkness.
steps: Follow the local route and instructions
hero.rhythmNote: Water level changes the experience. Do not treat a wet-season cave like the same activity in drier conditions; local operators and site staff should have the final say on whether the route is appropriate.

chapters.label: THE FORMAT
chapters.title: The water is not beside the cave — it is how you travel through it
chapters.body: Tham Nam changes the usual cave rhythm because you are not simply walking from chamber to chamber. The low water passage is commonly explored on a tube, which makes the visit slower, wetter and more dependent on current water conditions.

chapters.label: THE CONDITION
chapters.title: Let the river decide how ambitious the visit is
chapters.body: Rain can alter current, depth and visibility. Follow local instructions, use the available safety equipment and turn the activity into a shorter experience if conditions or confidence make that the sensible choice.

note.label: ATLAS NOTE
note.text: Tham Nam is memorable because the cave dictates the movement. Keep it playful, but treat the water seriously.

items.label: Format
items.detail: Expect to get wet and keep valuables protected.

items.label: Time
items.detail: The cave is commonly combined with other nearby stops, so allow for transfers and waiting as well as cave time.

items.label: Safety
items.detail: Local conditions matter more than an old online description, especially during the wet season.

items.label: Equipment
items.detail: Follow site or operator instructions and do not improvise with inadequate lighting.

faq.question: Do you walk through Tham Nam Water Cave?
faq.answer: The defining experience is moving through the water passage on an inner tube rather than treating it as a standard dry cave walk.

faq.question: Will I get wet?
faq.answer: Yes. Dress for water, protect electronics and valuables, and bring a dry layer for afterwards if needed.

faq.question: Is Tham Nam suitable in heavy rain?
faq.answer: Water conditions can change quickly. Follow current local guidance and do not enter if staff or operators consider the flow unsuitable.

faq.question: How much time should I allow?
faq.answer: Treat it as a half-day activity once transport and the common cave-circuit rhythm are included.
